title: Sarv Biolabs Exhibition Portal
designSystemStatus: light and dark design systems imported and active in Stitch

supplier_profile.title: Supplier Profile: Refined Header & Summary
supplier_profile.details: Assistance-led supplier profile with finalized company, primary/alternate contact, location, and Category → Subcategory → Equipment fields.

supplier_review.title: Supplier Review: Final Screen 05 Candidate
supplier_review.details: Fast Scan review screen. Catalogue upload and website URL are accepted independently or together; at least one is required. Location verification is handled automatically in code and has no visible evidence or permission UI.

supplier_confirmation.title: Supplier Inquiry: Production Confirmation Template
supplier_confirmation.details: Production-safe supplier confirmation template with explicit placeholders, internal review steps, and an exhibition-staff assistance route.

buyer_product_inquiry.title: Buyer Product Inquiry
buyer_product_inquiry.details: Approved base direction for buyer product-area selection or exact-requirement entry.

buyer_category.title: Buyer Inquiry: Minimalist Card Variant
buyer_category.details: Approved Minimalist Card direction for pharmacopeial standards (IP, USP, BP, PP, Other) and buyer requirement detail. Reverified as the sole retained Screen 08 design in Stitch after variation cleanup.

buyer_profile.title: Buyer Profile: Refined Consistency Update
buyer_profile.details: Approved Screen 09 aligned to the Supplier Profile form anatomy: compact header/progress, assistance strip, outlined mobile inputs, and fixed action bar, with buyer/company details and required plus optional consent.

buyer_confirmation.title: Buyer Inquiry: Submission Confirmation
buyer_confirmation.details: Approved base Screen 10: production-safe buyer acknowledgement with placeholder-only summary, no fabricated reference number or SLA, clear follow-up expectation, exhibition-staff correction route, and restart actions. Stitch canvas audit confirms it is the sole non-hidden Screen 10 item; the generated alternatives are hidden.

principles: Capture both sides of a business card before intent selection.
Confirm name, email, and phone with country code before progressing so partial records can be retained.
Persist meaningful progress server-side; QR payloads are captured for internal follow-up only and do not redirect the visitor.
Keep buyer requirements progressive and optional wherever sales can follow up.

detailsCheck.title: Extracted Details Confirmation
detailsCheck.details: Three-field identity checkpoint after card capture. Name, work email, and mobile number with country code establish the auto-saved partial inquiry before intent selection.

intentSelection.title: Intent Selection Portal
intentSelection.details: Post-save route selection retaining the first-person supplier and buyer paths. Buyer copy promises a quick inquiry with only known details.

supplierProductTypesRefined.title: Supplier Product Type Selection - Refined Mobile Flow
supplierProductTypesRefined.details: Replacement for the approved taxonomy screen after Stitch failed to render a targeted edit. It corrects the step count, confirms automatic saving, and leads to smart details review.

supplierSmartDetailsCheck.title: Supplier Smart Details Check - Step 3
supplierSmartDetailsCheck.details: Fast supplier details checkpoint: confirmed card extraction and selected taxonomy are previewed first. When extraction is complete it requires no further typing; otherwise it reveals only the genuinely missing required detail. Optional company context remains collapsed.

buyerRapidNeedCapture.title: Buyer Inquiry: Rapid Need Capture
buyerRapidNeedCapture.details: Replacement for the old buyer product inquiry and separate requirement-details screens. One required product-or-need entry is sufficient; saved contact details remove the profile form, while product-area search and specifications stay optional and collapsed.

buyerFinalReviewSubmit.title: Buyer Inquiry: Final Review & Submit
buyerFinalReviewSubmit.details: Final buyer checkpoint with only the entered requirement and the saved contact summary. Optional specifications are represented as a compact empty state; no company or profile form is reintroduced before submission.

buyerSubmissionConfirmationRevised.title: Buyer Inquiry: Submission Confirmation (Revised)
buyerSubmissionConfirmationRevised.details: Replacement confirmation for the streamlined buyer flow. It acknowledges the dynamic requirement and saved contact details without assuming a pharmacopeial category, standard, quantity, or response-time commitment.
